coverage_notes.observation: All 12 targeted queries returned results sufficient for bounded screening. No newly published and independently corroborated qualifying disruption in the hourly window was found. Many ostensibly recent indexed hits were older events or articles with newly updated sidebar/crawl metadata, not new events.

duplicate_screen.method: Read existing committed November 2 heartbeat on ops/watch-ledger; used the separately available latest prior run completion to bound the hourly search. Screened older recurring incidents by source and event dates.

coverage_notes.limitations: Search engine freshness limits are not reliable event timestamps; local notices may be unindexed or posted late. No assertion of complete nationwide coverage. No new finding inferred from crawl dates alone.
